name: disable_zapier_action
description: Remove an app's actions from this MCP server. Use list_enabled_zapier_actions to see which apps are enabled. Optionally specify an action key to remove only that specific action.

app.description: App name to remove (e.g., 'gmail', 'jira', 'slack'). Accepts short names or full IDs. Use list_enabled_zapier_actions to see enabled apps.

action.description: Specific action key to remove. If omitted, all actions for the app are removed.
